title: One Offset, Two Directions: Baseline Adjustment via Subgroup Offsets
abstract: arXiv:2611.00782v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) estimates advantages against the within-prompt mean reward, a baseline shared across the group. In practice, rollouts within a prompt are not always homogeneous, differing in their solution strategies and reasoning trajectories, along which they may group into subgroups. We further find that these heterogeneous subgroups may exhibit distinct reward distributions. The global baseline, however, collapses them onto a single credit axis, where the credit reflects neither a rollout's standing within its subgroup nor the subgroup's standing relative to the rest. We therefore study how to adjust the baseline when the rollouts of a prompt fall into heterogeneous subgroups. We define the \emph{subgroup offset} as the deviation of a subgroup mean from the global mean, and shift the baseline along it by a single signed coefficient $\lambda$. translated_title: 一个偏移量，两个方向：基于子群偏移的基线调整
translated_abstract: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）通过相对于提示内平均奖励——即组内共享的基线——来估计优势。在实践中，同一提示内的采样输出（rollouts）并不总是同质的，它们在求解策略和推理轨迹上存在差异，并可能据此聚合成子群。我们进一步发现，这些异质子群可能表现出各不相同的奖励分布。然而，全局基线将它们压缩到单一的信用轴上，此时信用既不反映某个采样输出在其子群内的相对位置，也不反映该子群相对于其余部分的地位。因此，我们研究当一个提示的采样输出落入异质子群时如何调整基线。我们将“子群偏移”定义为子群均值相对全局均值的偏差，并通过一个带符号的系数 λ 沿该偏移方向移动基线。λ 的符号产生两个相反的方向：……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用“子群偏移”（子群均值与全局均值的偏差）配合一个带符号的系数 λ 来调整 GRPO 的基线，以解决提示内采样输出因异质子群而产生不同奖励分布时的信用分配问题，且 λ 的正负号给出两种相反的基线调整方向。
en_tdlr: This paper adjusts GRPO's baseline via a "subgroup offset"—the deviation of a subgroup mean from the global mean—scaled by a single signed coefficient λ, addressing credit assignment when rollouts within a prompt form heterogeneous subgroups with distinct reward distributions, where the sign of λ yields two opposing adjustment directions.
